name: Javascript Tetris
state_js: ({score: window.score, rows: window.rows, playing: !!window.playing, current: window.current, next: window.next, blocks: window.blocks})
controls: Space starts a game. Left and right arrows move the falling piece. Up rotates. Down drops it one row per press. Fill a whole horizontal row to clear it. Escape ends the game.
goal: Clear at least one horizontal row.
notes: Run python -m tools.fetch_games first. Reads the game's global rows, score and pieces without changing game files. Random pieces and no replay frame counter: reports show Not reproducible and recordings use real time. Browser proof within about 40 steps is owed.
